patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I ran out of my blood-pressure medicine and my doctor's office is closed for the weekend. I feel completely fine — no headache, no chest pain — I just need a refill to get me through.
clinical.presentationShort: 55yo M — asymptomatic, out of antihypertensive meds, requesting a bridge refill, exam and BP acceptable — non-urgent.
clinical.presentationLong: 55-year-old male, asymptomatic, out of his antihypertensive medication and requesting a bridge refill, with an acceptable blood pressure and normal exam.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → short bridge prescription, counsel on continuity, PCP follow-up. No emergency care needed.
diagnosis.why: Asymptomatic, just out of routine meds → a bridge refill and PCP follow-up. Not an emergency; a fast discharge.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 55-year-old man, seated comfortably on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: relaxed, hands in his lap. Expression: calm and patient. Clearly visible: a healthy, well-looking man with no distress. No text, no logos.
